items.html: And afterward the mochin came out and were given to her herself, and then she grew her entire back, for she already has Neshama like him. And know and understand greatly that then all the aspects of the Malchut of ZA himself, which is his BaN as mentioned in another place, is like the Upper Bina, and she is like Tevuna; and all his Achoraim are sawed off and given to her, and through this she is completed. For she is like Tevuna, which becomes a complete Partzuf by joining with Bina.
